rationale: The EASA NPA 2025-07(B) document explicitly outlines a proposed detailed AI-trustworthiness framework. The provided excerpts and context from the NPA, specifically DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150, DS.AI.160, and GM1 AI.150, directly support that the framework spans operational domain (ODD), risk assessment (continuous risk assessment), system development assurance, supervised-ML learning assurance, configuration/life-cycle data, and in-service monitoring. The source and project artifacts consistently confirm its status as a Notice of Proposed Amendment (NPA) and proposed material, aligning with the claim's scope and status. The project's intent to compare its own evidence contracts against this framework is also explicitly stated in the project's internal documents.
